body:
# 📰 〡 Presentation

**Add realism to your roads** with Traffic Signs!
> **Standard signs installed along 🛣️ roadways...**

![Road with signs on each side](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/909efa371644eae1887356367ad75484cb54fc74.jpeg)

🛑 **Traffic signs** are signs erected at the side of or above roads to give instructions or provide information to road users.

## ❔ 〡 What's planned?

First, the French signs will be added, bringing the total to between 300 and 500.
Other regions are planned, such as the United States...
